tracks.title: First Light
tracks.suno_prompt: Ambient instrumental with a slow sunrise atmosphere, ethereal pad synths layered in D major, soft granular textures that shimmer like morning dew, a gentle Rhodes melody emerging after 30 seconds, very subtle brush percussion at 66 BPM, layered field recordings of distant birds and light breeze, warm analog tape saturation throughout, cinematic reverb tails that sustain for several seconds, no vocals, no drums for the first 20 seconds, gradual build from silence to a full warm wash of sound, focus and meditation music
tracks.human_edit_notes: Record a real sunrise field recording (birds, wind) and layer at -18dB under the synth pads during the intro. Apply a slow high-pass filter sweep from 200Hz to full spectrum over the first 15 seconds to simulate a sunrise bloom. Add manual volume automation to the Rhodes so it breathes naturally. Check that pad frequencies do not mask the Rhodes between 1-3kHz. Apply gentle stereo widening to the pads but keep the Rhodes centered. Master to -14 LUFS. Fade in from silence over 6 seconds.

tracks.title: Through the Glass
tracks.suno_prompt: Ambient lo-fi instrumental with a rainy indoor atmosphere, soft electric piano chords in A minor with gentle reverb, layered rain on glass sound textures throughout, slow minimal percussion at 72 BPM with brushed snare and light rim clicks, warm sub bass drone underneath, subtle vinyl crackle and tape hiss for warmth, muted string pad that enters halfway through, cozy and contemplative mood like sitting by a window watching rain fall, no vocals, deep focus study music with a bittersweet emotional edge
tracks.human_edit_notes: Record or source a high-quality rain-on-window field recording and layer it throughout at -15dB, panning slightly left. Add a second lighter rain texture panned right for stereo depth. Humanize the electric piano velocity so no two notes hit at the same level. Add a subtle low-pass filter on the string pad to keep it from competing with the piano. Insert a thunder rumble sample at very low volume around the 2-minute mark for atmosphere. Clean up any muddiness between the bass drone and piano left hand around 150-250Hz. Master with gentle compression.

tracks.title: Null State
tracks.suno_prompt: Ultra-minimal ambient electronic instrumental in C minor, sparse sine wave tones with long decay, a single repeating motif of three notes played on a soft digital bell synth, extremely subtle click percussion at 60 BPM almost inaudible, deep sub-bass pulse every 4 bars, wide stereo field with sounds placed precisely in the panorama, clinical and focused atmosphere like a clean white workspace, granular synthesis textures that drift in and out, no vocals, no melodic development just pure repetitive focus, minimal techno influence but without energy or buildup, designed for deep concentration and flow state
tracks.human_edit_notes: This track depends on extreme precision. Manually adjust the timing of the bell motif so each repetition has micro-variations in velocity (range 60-80 MIDI). Add a real-recorded pencil-on-paper foley sample at very low volume at two points in the track. Apply surgical EQ to the sine tones to remove any harmonic artifacts above 8kHz. Ensure the sub-bass pulse is felt but not heard — target 35-50Hz with a clean sine. Check mono compatibility rigorously as the wide stereo field may cause phase issues. Use a limiter ceiling of -1dB. This track should feel like silence with intention.

tracks.title: Golden Veil
tracks.mood: warm, nostalgic, reflective, golden, bittersweet calm
tracks.suno_prompt: Downtempo ambient instrumental evoking golden hour light, warm analog synthesizer pads in G major with slow filter sweeps, gentle plucked nylon guitar melody that feels nostalgic and tender, soft brushed drums at 68 BPM with a laid-back swing feel, a deep warm bass tone that pulses slowly beneath the mix, tape saturation and gentle wow and flutter for vintage character, cinematic reverb on the guitar, strings-like pad swells that rise and fall like breathing, no vocals, evening wind-down music that feels like watching a sunset from a quiet balcony, peaceful and reflective atmosphere
tracks.human_edit_notes: If possible replace the AI guitar with a real nylon guitar recording — even a simple 4-bar loop played live will add significant authenticity. Add a gentle high-shelf rolloff above 10kHz to simulate the warmth of golden hour sonically. Apply manual volume automation to the pad swells so they feel like natural breathing (4 seconds in, 6 seconds out). Layer a subtle wind chime or glass bell sample at very low volume during the second half. Adjust the drum swing manually to about 58% for a more human feel. Add 2dB of analog-style harmonic saturation to the master bus. Fade out over the final 10 seconds.

tracks.title: Desk Lamp
tracks.mood: studious, quiet, urban, late-night calm, solitary focus
tracks.suno_prompt: Late-night ambient chillhop instrumental in E minor, muted jazzy electric piano with a warm round tone, very soft boom-bap drums at 74 BPM with low velocity hits and vinyl crackle texture, distant city traffic sounds woven into the atmosphere, a gentle bass guitar line that walks slowly beneath the chords, subtle synth pad holding long notes in the background, the feeling of studying alone in a quiet apartment at 2am with a desk lamp as the only light, soft tape compression and lo-fi warmth throughout, no vocals, contemplative and focused mood, muted color palette in sound
tracks.human_edit_notes: Record a 30-second field recording of nighttime city ambience from a window (distant traffic, occasional siren far away) and loop it underneath at -22dB. Add a real bass guitar layer if available — even a simple root-note pattern will improve authenticity. Humanize the drum pattern by shifting hi-hat hits 5-15ms off-grid randomly. Apply a low-pass filter at 14kHz to the entire mix for that muted late-night character. Add a clock ticking sample at extremely low volume (-30dB) in the left channel. Check that the bass guitar and electric piano do not clash around 300-500Hz. Master to -14 LUFS with gentle limiting.

tracks.title: Salt and Drift
tracks.suno_prompt: Oceanic ambient instrumental in F major, deep evolving drone pads that rise and fall like tides, layered water and wave textures woven throughout the sound design, a distant melody played on a soft flute-like synth that appears and disappears like something heard across the water, very sparse percussion at 58 BPM using only soft tonal hits like wooden blocks and gentle shakers, wide stereo field that creates an immersive natural soundscape, sub-bass swells that mimic the rhythm of ocean waves, granular synthesis processing on the pads for organic shimmer, no vocals, meditation and deep focus music inspired by the vastness of the ocean at dawn, peaceful and expansive atmosphere
tracks.human_edit_notes: Source a high-quality ocean waves field recording and layer throughout at -12dB as a primary textural element. Apply sidechain compression from the wave recording to the synth pads so the music breathes with the ocean rhythm. Manually automate the flute synth volume so it fades in and out unpredictably, appearing only 3-4 times in the track. Add a subtle seagull call at very low volume once around the 1-minute mark. Ensure the sub-bass swells align roughly with the wave recording peaks. Apply convolution reverb using a cathedral or large hall impulse response to the flute synth. Remove any harsh frequencies in the granular textures above 6kHz. This is the longest track — ensure it sustains interest through textural evolution rather than melodic change.

tracks.title: Counter Seat
tracks.mood: warm, social, comfortable, grounded, gentle hum
tracks.suno_prompt: Warm coffee shop ambient instrumental in B-flat major, soft jazz piano chords with a gentle swing feel, muted upright bass playing simple walking patterns, brushed snare and light ride cymbal at 76 BPM with a relaxed groove, distant background chatter and coffee machine sounds blended into the atmosphere, warm tape saturation and subtle vinyl noise, a gentle tenor saxophone-like synth melody that plays a short phrase then rests, cozy and grounded mood like sitting at a counter in a favorite cafe on a rainy afternoon, analog warmth and vintage tone throughout, no vocals, lo-fi jazz focus music with a human and inviting atmosphere
tracks.human_edit_notes: Record or source a genuine coffee shop ambience recording (chatter, espresso machine, cups clinking) and layer at -16dB throughout. If any element sounds too synthetic, prioritize replacing the bass or brushed snare with real recordings. Adjust the piano velocity curve so louder notes peak around 75 MIDI velocity — nothing should feel too assertive. Add a brief coffee cup clink foley at 2-3 natural pause points in the arrangement. Apply gentle tape emulation with subtle pitch wobble. Roll off frequencies below 80Hz on everything except the bass. Add a very subtle room reverb to all instruments to place them in the same acoustic space. Ensure the saxophone synth does not sound artificial — if it does, replace with a filtered pad or remove entirely.

tracks.title: Parallax
tracks.suno_prompt: Space ambient electronic instrumental in D minor, vast evolving synthesizer pads with long attack and infinite sustain, deep cosmic drone textures that shift slowly like distant nebulae, a delicate high-register arpeggio played on a crystalline bell synth that echoes into reverb, extremely sparse percussion at 55 BPM using only soft metallic tones and resonant clicks, granular synthesis creating shimmering star-field textures in the high frequencies, deep sub-bass movements that feel gravitational, wide immersive stereo field with sounds that pan slowly across the panorama, no vocals, contemplative and awe-inspiring atmosphere like floating above Earth at night, designed for late-night deep focus and cosmic meditation, dark but peaceful emotional tone
tracks.human_edit_notes: This track requires careful attention to the stereo field and low-end. Apply slow automated panning to the granular textures (full L-R sweep over 16 bars). Ensure the sub-bass movements are in mono and centered. Add a subtle NASA radio transmission sample processed through heavy reverb and filtering at one point in the track as an easter egg. Manually draw the arpeggio velocity curve so it crescendos and decrescendos over 8-bar phrases. Apply a shimmer reverb (pitch-shifted feedback) to the bell synth. Check for any DC offset in the sub-bass. Remove any frequencies below 25Hz to protect playback systems. Add a 2-second silence before the track begins for dramatic effect. Apply dithering during final export. Master to -14 LUFS but allow the sub-bass transients to peak slightly louder for impact.

album_art_prompt: A minimalist landscape photograph rendered in muted teal and warm amber tones, depicting a solitary desk lamp casting a soft glow onto an open notebook beside a rain-streaked window at dusk, the cityscape beyond is softly blurred into bokeh lights, the composition is centered with generous negative space above, subtle film grain texture overlay, the overall feeling is calm focus and quiet productivity, ultra high resolution 3000x3000 pixels, square format, modern and clean aesthetic suitable for a music streaming thumbnail, no text or typography in the image
ai_disclosure: This album was created with the assistance of AI music generation tools. Human curation, arrangement, and mastering were applied to all tracks.

distribution.release_strategy: Release tracks 1 and 3 ('First Light' and 'Null State') as singles two weeks apart to build algorithmic momentum and capture playlist placements. Follow with the full 8-track album release two weeks after the second single. Time the album drop for a Monday to align with Spotify editorial playlist refresh cycles.
distribution.pre_save_notes: Create a Spotify pre-save link via DistroKid or Feature.fm. Promote on YouTube Community tab, Instagram Stories, and in Gumroad email list. Offer a free bonus track (extended mix of 'Null State') to pre-save participants.

marketing.youtube_visualizer_notes: Create 8 individual visualizer videos (static or slow-motion background with waveform or particle animation) plus one full-album video for long-form ambient streaming. Use Renderforest or After Effects templates. Titles should follow format: 'Dusk Memo — Track Name | Ambient Focus Music'. Include timestamps in the full-album video description.
marketing.playlist_pitch_strategy: Submit singles to Spotify for Artists editorial playlist consideration at least 7 days before release. Target 'Deep Focus', 'Brain Food', 'Peaceful Piano', 'Lo-Fi Beats', and 'Ambient Relaxation'. Pitch description should emphasize: instrumental focus music, ambient textures, ideal for study and work. Simultaneously submit to independent playlist curators via PlaylistPush or SubmitHub targeting ambient/focus/study categories.
marketing.cross_promotion: Use album tracks as background music in YouTube real estate and finance content. Bundle as a 'Focus BGM Pack' on Gumroad (WAV stems + full mixes) at $9.99. License individual tracks for podcast intros via the Gumroad store. Mention the album in YouTube video descriptions with Spotify link.

social_media.instagram_reels: Create 15-second mood clips for each track with matching visual aesthetic
social_media.tiktok: Post 'make ambient music with AI' process videos showing the workflow
social_media.reddit: Share in r/ambientmusic, r/studymusic, r/lofi with genuine engagement

legal_compliance.copyright_notes: All tracks must have demonstrable human creative input through arrangement, mixing, and mastering decisions. Suno-generated raw outputs are starting points only. Document all human edits in a production log for each track. Register tracks with a PRO (BMI or ASCAP) under the 'Dusk Memo' artist alias. Retain all generation logs and edit histories as proof of human involvement.
legal_compliance.field_recording_licensing: Ensure all field recordings used (rain, ocean, city, coffee shop) are either self-recorded or sourced from royalty-free libraries with commercial use licenses (e.g., Freesound.org CC0, Artlist, Epidemic Sound SFX).

revenue_estimate.scaling_notes: At 5,000 streams/month the album generates ~$20/month. Target 20,000 streams/month within 6 months through playlist placements and YouTube funnel for ~$80/month. Gumroad BGM pack adds estimated $30-50/month. Combined Phase 2 music revenue target: $100-130/month across all albums. Each subsequent album compounds streaming income as the artist profile grows.
revenue_estimate.time_investment: Album production: ~8 hours total (generation, editing, mastering, upload, marketing setup). Ongoing maintenance: <2 hours/week across all music projects (responding to playlist pitches, social posts, monitoring analytics).

production_workflow.step_1: Generate 3-5 variations per track in Suno using the suno_prompt for each track
production_workflow.step_2: Select the best generation for each track based on mood accuracy and sonic quality
production_workflow.step_3: Import into DAW (Ableton Live, Logic Pro, or Reaper) for human editing per human_edit_notes
production_workflow.step_4: Layer field recordings and foley samples as specified in each track's notes
production_workflow.step_5: Mix all 8 tracks with consistent tonal balance and volume levels across the album
production_workflow.step_6: Master to -14 LUFS integrated loudness for streaming platform normalization
production_workflow.step_7: Export final WAVs (44.1kHz/16-bit for distribution, 48kHz/24-bit for Gumroad pack)
production_workflow.step_8: Generate album art using the album_art_prompt via Midjourney or DALL-E, resize to 3000x3000px
production_workflow.step_9: Upload to DistroKid with AI-generated flag, instrumental tag, and correct metadata
production_workflow.step_10: Pitch singles to Spotify for Artists and set up pre-save campaign
